people.Damaghosha: King of Chedi; husband of Shrutashrava and father of Shishupala.
people.Shishupala: King of Chedi, cousin of Krishna; born three-eyed and four-armed under a doom that Krishna would kill him, which came to pass at Yudhishthira's rajasuya after his hundredth insult.

Karenumati.note: A princess of Chedi; wife of Nakula.

people.Dhrishtaketu: Son of Shishupala; king of Chedi after his father and an ally of the Pandavas in the war.
